services.desc: Give your child a summer to remember! Our Summer Discovery Camp offers a fun-filled week of learning and exploration, including science activities, outdoor adventures, and creative projects. Kids will make friends, build confidence, and have a blast! Every week is a different theme. Explorers are required to bring water and lunch each day.
